title: Cheers and applause as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia office
description: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.
text: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and president on Monday. President Trump has claimed credit for brokering the deal.
What is the mood at Nvidia following the announcement? BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return.
